clips.title: The story
paras: Farren's Proof is a short delivery mission in Southshore where an adventurer carries a grisly bounty of murloc heads from Lieutenant Farren Orinelle to Marshal Redpath. Having let someone else do the bloody work of hunting the coast, the squeamish lieutenant delegates the actual reporting as well. It marks an intermediate step in securing town recognition along the Hillsbrad coast.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is tasked with patrolling and securing the southern coastline of Hillsbrad Foothills, yet he has little stomach for the brutal realities of frontier warfare. After sending an adventurer out to cull the rampant murlocs infesting the beaches, he balks at actually touching the severed heads brought back as proof. Rather than personally marching the dripping trophies to Southshore's town command, Farren gladly dumps the errand right back onto the bearer.

Across Southshore, Marshal Redpath oversees the town's defensive operations and military readiness amidst mounting threats from Tarren Mill and wild beast populations. Receiving a sack of murloc heads via courier rather than directly from his lieutenant hardly surprises him. While recognizing that the adventurer has become Farren's errand runner, Redpath is pragmatic enough to accept the assistance, knowing Southshore requires all the diligent labor it can muster to keep its borders intact.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You know, friend, I'd really rather not take these heads...
Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, citizen. Have you come to lend your arm to upholding the safety of Southshore?

clips.title: Completion
paras: If you assisted Farren in procuring these heads, then thank you. Southshore needs hard workers and effort to maintain its protection.
